title: REQ · Open and close rounds with frozen snapshot and recorded Git commit SHA
summary: Create/open/close service, snapshot.yaml freeze, Git HEAD lookup and frozen guard
description: Context: no code creates, opens or closes rounds. Desired behavior: Open records start/end (24h default) and base release; Close writes snapshot.yaml once listing contributions, commits it, records the exact SHA from the Git interface, sets CLOSED; frozen rounds reject new contribution files. Expected result: contribution snapshot is immutable. Why: the Worker needs a stable input.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SCHEDULED round, when opened with no duration, then ends_at = starts_at + 24h and base_release is recorded
Given an OPEN round, when closed, then snapshot.yaml lists its contributions, freeze_commit equals the SHA returned by Head, status is CLOSED
Given snapshot.yaml exists, when FileStore.Save is called for that round, then ErrFrozen is returned and no file is created
Given a round that is not OPEN, when closed, then ErrIllegalTransition is returned and no snapshot is written

preserve: contribution Save semantics for open rounds

technical_constraints: snapshot written with O_EXCL and mode 0o444
Git access only through the gitrepo interface
non_functional: Serialize lifecycle operations with a mutex
